name: GlyphAtlas::bake

test_list.description: Baking RAMP with JetBrains Mono yields one bitmap per ramp glyph.
A character absent from the font (U+E000) fails with AuroraError::MissingGlyph carrying that character.
Garbage font bytes fail with AuroraError::Font.
Every glyph bitmap is exactly cell_w * cell_h bytes and rows are cell_w wide.
A zero cell width or height fails with AuroraError::Size.
The space glyph has zero coverage; the densest glyph has ink, ink is centred inside the cell and the glyph height is about 0.62 of the cell height.

output_description: One u8 coverage bitmap per ramp glyph, cell-sized, glyph centred by advance and baseline.
